text:
Predicates:
WorksInLibrary(x) ::: x works in the library.
Student(x) ::: x is a student.
FromCSDepartment(x) ::: x is from the computer science department.
HasPartTimeJob(x) ::: x has a part-time job offered by the university.
TakesCourse(x, y) ::: x takes course y.
Instructor(x, y) ::: x instructs y.
LabWorker(x) ::: x works in the lab.
Year(y) ::: y is a year.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
PublishedIn(y, z) ::: y is published in year z.
Specialize(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
Love(x, y) ::: x loves y.
Author(x, y) ::: x is the author of y.
Miroslav ::: the individual Miroslav Venhoda.
Music ::: the concept of music.
GregorianChant ::: Gregorian Chant.
MethodOfStudyingGregorianChant ::: the book "Method of Studying Gregorian Chant".
ProfessorDavid ::: Professor David.
James ::: James.
Jack ::: Jack.

Premises:
¬∃x (Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x) ∧ HasPartTimeJob(x)) ::: No students who work in the library are from the computer science department.
∀x (HasPartTimeJob(x) ∧ OfferByUniversity(x) → Student(x) ∧ WorksInLibrary(x)) ::: All students who have part-time jobs offered by the university are students who work in the library.
∀x (TakesCourse(x, GregorianChant) → FromCSDepartment(x)) ::: All students who take the Gregorian Chant course are from the computer science department.
∀x (Instructor(x, y) ∧ y = GregorianChant → TakesCourse(x, GregorianChant)) ::: All students instructed by Professor David are taking the Gregorian Chant course.
∀x (WorksInLab(x) → Instructor(x, ProfessorDavid)) ::: All students working in the lab are instructed by Professor David.
James ::: James.
WorksInLab(James) ::: James works in the lab.
Jack ::: Jack.
¬HasPartTimeJob(Jack) ::: Jack does not have a part-time job offered by the university.
¬WorksInLab(Jack) ::: Jack does not work in the lab.

Conclusion:
Does James have a part-time job offered by the university?
